_comment: The world-state flag registry, per brief section 45.
Declaring flags here rather than letting them spring into existence on first
write is the point. Brief section 45 lists flags driving dialogue, NPC
placement, quests, recruitments, map state, shops and endings, and a typo in
any of those is a silently dead branch. `hollowasset validate-content`
checks that every flag written by a battle or a dialogue scene is declared
here, and reports declared flags nobody reads.
`readBy` is documentation of intent for flags whose consumer does not exist
yet, so a flag set in the prologue for an Act IV payoff is not mistaken for

flags.description: The Crownwall has a passable gap near the old watchtower.
Rowan is officially declared a traitor by the crown.
Refugees from beyond the Wall passed through the breach.
The party has seen an aberration and knows what comes through the Wall.
Aldric turned his sword on Varric and let Rowan go.
Tomas stayed behind to tell Greenvale what really happened.
Which line Rowan used to refuse Varric. Changes tone only, never outcome.
flags.notes: The script is explicit that this choice does not alter Rowan's action. It exists so the player's Rowan has a voice, and later companion dialogue can echo it.

flags.description: The player inspected the unusually cold well.
flags.notes: Optional foreshadowing. Rewards curiosity per brief section 97 without gating anything.

flags.description: The gate guard warned about the shaking ground at the watchtower.
A goblin spearman escaped north toward the Wall rather than fighting.
flags.notes: Set by the mid-battle event. The goblins running toward the Wall, not away from the party, is the first sign the goblins are fleeing something too.

flags.description: The Goblin Charm's true nature has been revealed.
flags.notes: Deliberately has no setter yet. The reveal belongs to a later chapter, and declaring it now keeps the item's revealFlag reference valid.

flags.description: The party found the overturned cart with no merchant and human footprints leading north.
